_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Falköping C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Still withheld after the research pass: With the platform numbers from Trafikverket (1–2, 3–4) only one platform drafts, and OSM joins no footway to it; the research's 4 entrances have nothing to attach to. Needs the walkways from a plan or a walk.
